title: Fedimint SDK for React Native
summary: Add ecash to a React Native wallet with the Fedimint npm packages: install them, join a federation, show a balance, receive and send ecash and Lightning, list history, share the session with React hooks, and restore from seed words.

pages.title: Welcome
pages.description: What the SDK does, what is proven, and where to start.

pages.title: Quickstart
pages.description: From an empty app to a balance on screen in one page.

pages.title: Installation
pages.description: Install the two npm packages, link them on iOS and Android, and see the SDK answer on a device.

pages.title: Join a federation
pages.description: Read an invite code, preview a federation, join it, and reconnect on every launch.

pages.title: Show a balance
pages.description: Read the balance once, then follow it as it changes.

pages.title: Receive money
pages.description: Redeem ecash, and create and watch a Lightning invoice.

pages.title: Send money
pages.description: Quote and send ecash, take it back, and pay a Lightning invoice.

pages.title: See the history
pages.description: Page through operations and turn each one into a row.

pages.title: Share the session
pages.description: Open the SDK once in a module your app owns, share the session, and follow it with hooks.

pages.title: Restore from seed words
pages.description: Open a wallet from seed words and recover each federation.

pages.title: Errors
pages.description: Exception and its codes, and how to explain a failure.

pages.title: Amounts
pages.description: Units, conversion, and the amount types.

pages.title: Seed words
pages.description: Open the wallet once, and show the seed words only to their owner.

pages.title: Overview
pages.description: Every method the guides use, in groups, with a link to a page for each.
